leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a generic type that accepts an object type as a parameter
Manipulate mapped types to transform object properties
Apply conditional types to enforce property requirements
Integrate union types to create flexible type constraints
Configure the RequireAtLeastOne type to ensure at least one property is present
Implement type utilities that combine multiple TypeScript features
Apply the RequireAtLeastOne type to real-world object scenarios
